Mamata Banerjee Launches New Party, Gets 'Football Player' Symbol

Mamata Banerjee has launched a new political party named 'Mata All India Trinamool Congress'. The Election Commission of India has allocated the party the election symbol of a 'Football Player'. The party name and symbol were reportedly given to former footballer and Trinamool Congress leader Ritabrata Banerjee. The Election Commission's decision was communicated via an envelope.
